Thanks
Shivaram

>
> Maybe there is a bug in the implementation of reduceByKey. I am not sure.
>
>             reduceVals <- function(part) {
>               vals <- new.env()
>               keys <- new.env()
>               lapply(part,
>                      function(item) {
>                        hashVal <- as.character(hashCode(item[[1]]))
>                        if (exists(hashVal, vals)) {
>                          vals[[hashVal]] <- do.call(
>                            combineFunc, list(vals[[hashVal]], item[[2]]))
>                        } else {
>                          vals[[hashVal]] <- item[[2]]
>                          keys[[hashVal]] <- item[[1]]
>                        }
>                      })
